# spotlight_runner_trust (List Resource)

Lists the runner trusts in a workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "spotlight_runner_trust" "all" {
  provider = spotlight

  config {
    workspace_id = "5b1e9d2c-7a43-4f8e-b6c0-3d9a8e1f2b57"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace to list in.
